Ur-Ge Destek Programı: The abbreviation of the Program for the Support of the Development of International Competitiveness, offered by the Ministry of Trade to the enterprises in similar sectors that export or are considering exporting. US-97 Code: the abbreviation of the expression 'national activity and product classification' describing the good and service the enterprises will produce, during the application for the investment incentive certificate.
Util: The theoretical unit of measurement used in cardinal utility calculation.
Uyarlanabilir beklentiler önsavı: The view maintaining that economic units determine their forecasts for the future on the basis of backward-looking information.
Uygulama gecikmesi: The period passing between the understanding of an adverse situation formed in the economy and the taking of the measures that will correct this situation.
Uygulamaları: The incentive implementation in which, in the event of investment in the sectors and under the conditions determined for the provinces located in 6 different regions according to their socio-economic development levels, the support elements of VAT Exemption, Customs Duty Exemption, Tax Reduction, Insurance Premium Employer's Share Support, Interest or Profit Share Support, Income Tax Withholding Support, Insurance Premium Support and Investment Site Allocation are offered.
Uzun dönem: In the microeconomic context, the conceptual time interval in which entry into or exit from the market is possible and all the production factors are variable. In the macroeconomic context, it is the conceptual time interval in which prices and wages are variable and the production factors can show full mobility among regions and sectors.
Uzun dönem ortalama gider: Or in short LRAC: the total cost incurred per unit of product in the long run, depending on the scale selected.
Uzun dönem Phillips eğrisi: Or in short LRPC: a graphical tool showing the relationship between the unemployment and inflation rates in the case where expected and realized inflation equal one another.
Uzun dönem piyasa arz eğrisi: A graphical tool showing the long-run relationship between the price of a good and the quantity supplied in the market, all else being constant.
Uzun dönem toplam arz eğrisi: Or in short LRAS: a graphical tool showing the long-run relationship between the general price level and the quantity of aggregate supply, all else being constant.
Vade: The repayment period or date of the debt taken.
Vadeli İşlemler Sözleşmesi: It means forward transactions. It envisages the delivery of a certain instrument, at a previously determined price, again on a previously determined date. The transactions are generally not carried out in organized markets, but with the buyer and seller coming face to face, in line with the parties' needs. Such contracts, which can be arranged over instruments subject to purchase and sale such as foreign currency, securities and commodities, can be directed toward speculative aims as well as eliminating price risk.
Vadesiz mevduat: The bank accounts into which money can be deposited and withdrawn whenever desired, or which can be used for payment purposes.
Vadeye Kadar Getiri: Refers to the return that will be obtained as a result of a security being held until its maturity. Its English equivalent is also called the 'effective rate of return'.
Valör: The date on which a transaction on which agreement has been reached will actually be carried out — for example, on which receivables and debts will be mutually recorded into the accounts. Similarly, it expresses the date on which a fund, for example a deposit, can actually be used by its owner.
Varlık / Yükümlülük İlkesi: The asset/liability principle is based on the showing of all debts and receivables to non-residents as gross assets and liabilities for the stocks, and by netting each category for the flows.
Varlık devir hızı: The ratio of sales to total assets (Sales / Total Assets); it measures the effectiveness of the assets in generating sales. This is the Turkish standard, in place of 'activity coefficient'.
Varlık kârlılığı: The ratio of net profit to total assets (Net profit / Total Assets); it shows how efficiently the asset base generates profit.
Varlıklar: The balance sheet section showing the economic values held by or receivable to an organization.
Varlığa Dayalı Menkul Kıymet: The instruments of value that institutions can issue in return for the receivables that have arisen from their own commercial transactions. Consumer credits, housing credits and the receivables arising from export transactions are among the types of receivables that can be subject to this transaction. By selling asset-backed securities, banks can convert their receivables into cash beforehand.
Veblen malı: A conspicuous-consumption good whose quantity demanded increases rather than decreases as its price rises.
Vega: The sensitivity of the option price to a one percent change in volatility; an increase in volatility raises the value of call and put options.
Vergi: The payments that the state legally and obligatorily collects from persons and institutions with the aim of covering public expenditures.
Vergi İndirimi Desteği: An investor making an investment within the scope of an investment incentive certificate containing the tax reduction support element can pay income or corporate tax at reduced rates, varying according to the region where the investment is being made, and can continue benefiting from this reduction until reaching the investment contribution amount, at rates again varying by region.
Vergi Matrahı: The value or quantity taken as the basis in the calculation of the tax. The tax debt is calculated by applying a tax schedule to the base. Tax bases are of two kinds, value-based and quantity-based. An ad valorem base (value-based) is calculated taking the values of the economic elements as the basis, and a certain tax rate is set for this base. A specific base (quantity-based) is a base applied to tax subjects with low monetary value.
Vergi Muafiyeti: The transaction of the exclusion from tax, by the same or different tax laws, of the persons or groups of persons who are originally obliged to pay tax according to the tax laws.
Vergi yansıması: The concept describing how the tax is shared between the buyers and sellers in the market.
Vergi çarpanı: The coefficient showing how much effect a unit change in autonomous taxes will have on equilibrium income.
Veri Depolama Kuruluşu: The institutions defined within the scope of the over-the-counter derivative market reform, to which the purchase and sale transaction data realized in the over-the-counter derivative markets are reported.
X-Inefficiency: 'X-inefficiency', first put forward by Leibenstein in 1956, is the increase in welfare loss as a result of the monopolistic firm's not reducing its costs to the lowest possible level (paying high salaries, excessive employment, etc.), because it feels no competitive pressure whatsoever.
Yakalama etkisi: The hypothesis that per capita income in poor countries tends to rise faster than in rich countries.
Yakın monopson: A market structure in which a product supplied by more than one seller is demanded to a very large extent by a single buyer, and obstacles lie before the entry of other buyers into the market.
Yakın tekel: A market structure in which a product without close substitutes is supplied to a very large extent by a single seller, and obstacles lie before entry into the market.
Yansız mal: In market analysis, the good whose demand is not dependent on income; in utility analysis, the good that provides no benefit to economic units but brings no harm either.
Yapı Kullanma İzin Belgesi: (Occupancy Certificate) The document given by the licensing authority showing that a completed construction is usable or partly usable, and that the built structure was made as stated in the project.
Yapısal Bankacılık Reformları: The reforms that came to the agenda with the emergence, along with the crisis, of the problems caused by the universal banking model offering many different products and services under the same roof, and that fundamentally envisage the gathering of the departments of banks conducting their risky and complex transactions under separate legal personalities.
Yapısal Bütçe Dengesi: The budget balance that would form in the case where the realized production level equals the potential production level; it is obtained by subtracting the cyclical budget balance from the realized budget balance. The structural budget balance is calculated with a three-stage method: in the first stage, the budget expenditures and revenues sensitive to cyclical movements must be determined, and the revenue and expenditure elasticities calculated. Secondly, potential output and output gap series are created in order to define the cyclical movements. In the third stage, the revenue and expenditure elements stemming from the cyclical movements are subtracted from the realized budget balance. In calculating the structural budget balance, the sifting out of the one-off revenue and expenditure items also carries importance.
Yapısal işsizlik: The type of unemployment stemming from the mismatch, in the labor market, between the skills employers seek and the skills the job seekers possess.
Yapışkan fiyatlar: The concept describing the situation in which some prices cannot immediately respond to the supply and demand changes in the economy.
Yapışkan ücretler: The concept describing the situation in which some wages cannot immediately respond to the supply and demand changes in the economy.
Yatay birleşme: The merger of two rival firms located in the same market.
Yatırım: The investments made in the medium-low technology group, such as the manufacturing of coke and refined petroleum products, plastic products, glass and metal structural materials, determined according to the OECD technology intensity definition.
Yatırım Anketi - YA: A survey applied twice a year with the aim of capturing the current investment tendencies of the workplaces operating in the industrial sector and their investment plans for the near future, and the assessments relating to the purpose of these investments and the factors effective in the workplace managers' investment decisions. To access the Investment Survey
Yatırım Danışmanlığı: In the broadest expression, the giving of written or oral opinions and advice in the works to be carried out for the investors on any investment instrument. Through investment consultancy, the investor receives consultancy services from the expert/authorized/designated institutions and organizations for the information, orientation, opinion-taking and planning activities it needs at every stage of the investment it has planned.
Yatırım eğrisi: A graphical tool showing the relationship between the interest rate and planned investment expenditures, all else being constant.
Yatırım Fonları: The form taken by the moneys collected from the public in return for participation certificates being converted, by the investment companies, into a portfolio consisting of capital market instruments and of the gold and other precious metals traded on the national and international exchanges. These funds, managed by the investment companies, provide returns to investors in different ways depending on their properties and investment areas.
Yatırım harcaması çarpanı: The coefficient showing how much effect a unit change in investment expenditures will have on equilibrium income.
Yatırım Kredisi: The credit obtained from external sources with the aim of meeting firms' investment needs and supporting the projects they design to develop within this scope.
Yatırım Ortaklığı: The capital market institutions established in the form of joint-stock companies, on the registered capital principle, in order to operate a portfolio of capital market instruments and of gold and other precious metals traded on the national and international exchanges or on the off-exchange organized markets.
Yatırım Teşvik Sistemi: The program brought into force with the 'Decree Amending the Decree on State Aids in Investments No. 2012/3305', offering incentive facilities directed toward investors.
